integrity: Original claims are the sharp second-derivative junction, angular lower bound, and inverse response interpretation; planar Cheeger-radius characterization, Steiner formula, rounding criterion and inset polygon quadratic are explicitly attributed to earlier literature.
scientific_limitations: Exact convex Euclidean polygon and exact Cheeger profile; near-threshold below branch only; recovers the corner-angle sum rather than individual angles or polygon; no nonconvex, high-dimensional or noisy-data statement.
title: A sharp second-derivative Cheeger corner signature for rounded convex polygons
